NEOW.talk.HEARTMOD-HEART_MOD.0-0r.ancien: Your current form... is so laughable...
NEOW.talk.HEARTMOD-HEART_MOD.1-0r.ancien: You... willingly... step into... the cycle...?
NEOW.talk.HEARTMOD-HEART_MOD.2-0r.ancien: All that has passed... you... have forgotten...
NEOW.talk.HEARTMOD-HEART_MOD.2-1r.char: I will ascend the throne and do better.
NEOW.talk.HEARTMOD-HEART_MOD.2-2r.ancien: At least... our goal... is the same...
